steps.en: Owner mobile numbers come from stored records
steps.id: Nomor mobile owner diambil dari data yang sudah tersimpan
steps.why_en: The lookup from an external data source is switched off; only stored numbers are used.
steps.why_id: Pencarian ke sumber data luar dimatikan; hanya nomor tersimpan yang dipakai.

steps.en: Each unique individual owner is picked only once per run
steps.id: Tiap pemilik individu unik dipilih hanya sekali per pengiriman
steps.why_en: The system sends one SMS per notice, so an owner with several notices gets several SMSes.
steps.why_id: Sistem mengirim satu SMS per notice, jadi pemilik dengan banyak notice dapat banyak SMS.

steps.en: Individual owners get SMS; companies do not
steps.id: Pemilik individu dapat SMS; perusahaan tidak
steps.why_en: Story is Removed; code exists but is not claimed
steps.why_id: Story Removed; code ada tapi tidak diklaim

steps.en: SMS text comes from a template staff can edit
steps.id: Isi SMS berasal dari template yang bisa diedit staff
steps.why_en: Story is Removed; code exists but is not claimed
steps.why_id: Story Removed; code ada tapi tidak diklaim

steps.en: SMS shows charges and due date, but no admin fee
steps.id: SMS memuat biaya dan tanggal jatuh tempo, tanpa admin fee
steps.why_en: No admin fee value is passed to the SMS text; admin fee is only applied at later letter stages.
steps.why_id: Nilai admin fee tidak dikirim ke teks SMS; admin fee baru dipakai di tahap surat berikutnya.

steps.en: The system sends the SMS to each owner automatically
steps.id: Sistem mengirim SMS ke tiap pemilik secara otomatis
steps.why_en: Sending is built, but the automatic schedule is switched off in the settings and not yet live.
steps.why_id: Fitur kirim sudah ada, tapi jadwal otomatisnya dimatikan di pengaturan dan belum aktif.
